question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**dining**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the idea of bringing people together through food and cooking at home.
 
• The most appropriate word to complete the phrase "over the _______ table" is "dining" because it refers to the table where people eat meals together.
 
• "**Dining**" fits well as it aligns with the context of sharing meals and bonding with family or friends.
 
• Other options ("**console**", "**study**", "**vanity**") do not fit naturally in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Console (कंसोल): A console is a piece of furniture or a control panel, which does not fit in the context of a meal table.
 
• Study (अध्ययन): A study refers to a room or an act of learning, which is irrelevant to the idea of dining and sharing meals.
 
• Vanity (दर्पण मेज): A vanity is a table used for grooming or makeup, which does not relate to the idea of eating together.
